observations: Two retail boxes for Mikorean brand power banks.
Left box is model MGP-L037, labeled 50000mAh.
Right box is model MGP-L012, labeled 50000mAh.
Both boxes show built-in charging cables and digital displays.
The right box (MGP-L012) indicates 22.5W Super Fast Charge.
The boxes are wrapped in thin plastic film.
The actual power bank units are not visible outside of their packaging.
